title: Concept: Lockfile entry records no supported Node version
description: package-lock.json declares a package entry that declares no supported Node runtime, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: Nothing tells the build whether the package was tested on the runtime that executes it, so a mismatch fails at run time rather than at review.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through package-lock.json (npm).
risk: Nothing tells the build whether the package was tested on the runtime that executes it, so a mismatch fails at run time rather than at review.
